findings.description: `save(p)` records a photo in `saveAll.handed` but neither checks whether Save all is busy nor prevents the batch from using its earlier snapshot. If someone taps an individual photo during a laptop download batch, its download starts immediately and the batch downloads the same photo again when it reaches that entry.
findings.title: Photo taps duplicate batch downloads

findings.description: `saveBatch()` counts an unfinished photo only while its ID remains in `incoming`, but the chunk handler removes that ID before asynchronous fingerprint verification finishes. A tap during that verification interval finds the photo in neither `incoming` nor `files`, so Save all can say “Nothing new to save” instead of counting it as still arriving.
findings.title: Verifying photos disappear from counts

findings.description: `tap()` keeps `busy` true until `share(list)` settles, with no recovery path for a promise that remains pending. If the browser never settles that promise, every later Save all tap returns “Still saving” for the rest of the page session, including taps made after new photos arrive.
findings.title: An unsettled share blocks later saves
